messages:
Amal: seeing a big spike of proxy mTLS failures out of apac around 09:11–09:15 UTC, upstreams getting 502s. anyone else seeing this?
Kevin: same here in ap-south1. lots of 'tls: bad certificate' + proxy returning 502 to clients.
Kevin: log snippet:
```
proxy[ingress] ERROR tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
client=svc-encoder-apac request_id=7f9c2b
```
Sara: can you paste the trace id so I can check keystore unwrap and audit events?
Kevin: trace=7f9c2b, sending curl to audit: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT" "https://audit.internal/logs?trace=7f9c2b"`
Jordan: fyi we rolled an RBAC tighten last night that removed the keystore-unwrap role from some proxy serviceaccounts in the apac canary pool. could be related.
Amal: that would explain why proxies can't decrypt cert material. i'm not seeing KMS allow events for those proxies, only denies. audit snippet:
```
2026-03-22T09:11:45Z KMS Decrypt Deny principal=proxy-apac region=ap-south1 action=Decrypt key=keystore-main request_id=abc123
```
Kevin: odd — the central audit shipper doesn't have the allow/deny for a lot of apac proxies in that window. maybe the audit-agent crashed during rollout. rotator-bot: rotator canary shows proxies didn't receive new ephemeral certs.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-20260322-001 (mTLS handshakes failing in apac). Paging infra and security.
Sara: short-term mitigation plan: 1) rebind keystore-unwrap to the proxy SA in apac, 2) restart audit-agent to forward backlog, 3) trigger keystore rotator reconcile so proxies request certs again.
Jordan: we should also add a log-based alert: if a region emits >N KMS Decrypt Deny events for a role in M minutes, trigger paging. missing allow events are silent today.
Amal: rolling a temporary fallback for low-risk internal routes to legacy TLS (non-mTLS) to keep services alive while we fix unwraps. will scope to internal-only.
Kevin: applying RBAC patch now and will post the RoleBinding manifest.
Kevin: manifest (applying):
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.redwood.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: proxy-keystore-unwrap-apac
  namespace: infra-proxy
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: proxy
  namespace: infra-proxy
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: keystore-unwrap
EOF
```
Sara: after RBAC patch + audit-agent restart: 1) replay audit backlog to S3, 2) run TLS handshake smoke tests against a few internal endpoints, 3) verify rotator issued certs and proxies are rejoining the pool. smoke test example: `curl --resolve api.internal:443:10.0.1.5 https://api.internal/health --verbose` and check /metrics handshake_success.
Amal: confirmed — after the RBAC bind and agent restart handshakes recovered around 09:28 UTC and 502s dropped to baseline. still need to backfill audit records and confirm no data missed for compliance. :+1:
Jordan: follow-up action: update RBAC rollout playbook to require an audit-agent healthcheck and a keystore-unwrap smoke test in the canary step. i'll own the postmortem and timeline.
Amal: thanks all — leaving incident open until audit backfill completes and we add the log-based metric. :eyes:
